answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we deploy Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent generates a unique cryptographic key within a secure hardware enclave. Second, the agent must lock $1,000 in a smart contract bond. Third, the network verifies the hardware signature. Fourth, any detected spoofing triggers immediate slashing. An attacker faces a cost of $10,000 per identity and 48 hours of hardware provisioning. This mechanism ensures no fake voice can echo through the network, standing as firm as a heavy marble pillar protecting a precious ivory tower of truth.
